description_en: Adds or modifies a data masking whitelist
description_zh: 调用DsgWhiteListAddOrUpdate接口，新增或编辑脱敏白名单
name: DsgWhiteListAddOrUpdate

element_fields.help_en: The ID of the data masking rule. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2786578.html operation to query the ID of the data masking rule
element_fields.help_zh: 脱敏规则ID。您可调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2786578.html接口获取
element_fields.name: rule_id

element_fields.help_en:
The ID of the data masking whitelist.

*   If you do not configure this parameter, the current operation is to add a data masking whitelist.
*   If you configure this parameter, the current operation is to modify a data masking whitelist. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2786508.html operation to query the whitelist ID
element_fields.help_zh:
脱敏白名单ID。
- 不配置该参数：表示当前操作为新增脱敏白名单。
- 配置该参数：表示编辑指定脱敏白名单信息。您可调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2786508.html接口查询白名单ID
element_fields.name: id

element_fields.help_en: The beginning of the time range to query
element_fields.help_zh: 脱敏白名单的生效时间
element_fields.name: start_time

element_fields.help_en: The end of the time range to query. If you enter null, the whitelist is valid permanently
element_fields.help_zh: 脱敏白名单的失效时间。输入null表示白名单永久生效
element_fields.name: end_time

element_fields.help_en: A collection of user group IDs
element_fields.name: user_group_ids
